# October 2026

The first tests fall in the two weeks before the break. The September week stays as it is until the 16th. From the 19th classes stop for two weeks and the holiday week takes over: the long blocks move to the morning and the afternoons stay free.

# Goals

Educational

- [ ] Maths: 17 or more at the test
- [ ] Coding: finish the parser exercise
- [ ] Miss fewer than two classes
- [ ] Puzzles: one hour every Saturday
- [ ] Finish the first book on the list

Financial

- [ ] No side job: the course is the job this term
- [ ] End the month at or above the planned balance

Personal

- [ ] In bed by 23h00, six nights out of seven
- [ ] Cardio four times a week
- [ ] A long walk with a friend every Sunday
